summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group filed a Form 6-K to report a difference in consolidated financial results for FY2026 vs. FY2025 under Japanese exchange rules. Ordinary profit rose by 34%, driven by higher net interest income, fee income, and strong wealth/consumer finance businesses. No transaction, tender, or strategic event is described—only routine earnings revision disclosure. Consequently, the 6-K is classified as a routine current report.
